fact.statement: E13 S7 stopped at s7_burned_text_verify: the H3 burned-text cover check failed with blocker H3_BURNED_TEXT_STILL_VISIBLE, exit 2, after 8 CJK OCR hits outside the caption bar.

cause.statement: The check was scoped to every CJK character in the frame rather than to the dialogue line H3 burns into the burn band: the 8 hits were the meaningless characters generated on VU-014's gate plaque and door couplet (y 0.00-0.14), already reported as P2 scene signage at Q2, where the period/anachronism OCR gate owns scene signage.

evidence.statement: Q2's submitted review records the plaque/couplet characters on VU-014 as non-subtitle set text and rates the scene P2, not a dialogue-subtitle failure.
The Q2 proposal line owner Roger answered on 2026-11-01 states the cover policy's purpose: hide the burned spoken line, and QC it by OCR outside the bar.
The PASS artefact records exactly those 8 hits as ignored_non_dialogue_text while text_outside_bar and text_inside_bar_not_the_caption are both empty.

rule_source.clause: scene signage away from the burn band is the period/anachronism gate's business
rule_source.note: carried in the verification report's rule string; the same narrowing is configured as verify.dialogue_band_pad=0.10 in configs/H3_BURNED_TEXT_COVER_V1.json:11

verification.measurement: H3 burned-text cover verdict over the same recorded OCR hits and captions: the dialogue-line scope PASSes, the pre-rule code FAILs on the 8 plaque hits

before.note: the FAIL report was overwritten at the same path by the later PASS; the preserved evidence is this log's exit=2 plus the replay of the pre-rule code over the same recorded hits

disabled_variant.note: the commit the rule landed on is 20dcd9d; 7ed3399 is its parent, the last revision without the dialogue-line scope

verification.assertion: tools/burned_text_cover.verify() over E13's recorded OCR hits and burn-in captions returns PASS with the dialogue-line scope and the 8 plaque hits in ignored_non_dialogue_text, and returns FAIL on those same 8 rows when the module is loaded from the last revision before the rule (7ed3399); the clause text is present only in the with-rule output.

real_run_consumption.reason: the rule was written after E13's S7 runs that exercised it; no later real build has run since, so only a free replay proves the clause is consumed. Set to CONSUMED_BY_REAL_RUN only when a later run's own output carries the clause.
